title: Bellaire Medical: staff member cut off in the front storage closet, oxygen cylinders

lines.text: 911, what is the address of your emergency?
Six five five zero Mapleridge Street, Bellaire Medical Professional Building. The big open area is on fire!
Our medical assistant went into storage room one twenty, the closet at the front, to grab an oxygen cart, and now she can't get past the flames!
Are there any hazards in that closet?
Yes. We keep oxygen cylinders in there, at least four of them.
Is everyone else out of the building?
Yes, everyone else is out. I'm across the street.
Stay back from the building. Firefighters are on the way.
